round4.about: Round 4: job-board has a second dedupe that empties sites. Its Workday cross-site dedupe skips a new requisition copy (an id ending in a one- or two-digit suffix after three digits, R31339-1) on any site of a tenant when a stored row of another site holds the base id (R31339). The corpus sibling check matched exact ids only, so it read 0 on every row that dedupe empties. sibling_served now also counts, on a Workday row, an in-window copy whose base id the read-only list serves under a sibling site, recomputed from the recheck round's saved sibling-served map and feed reads (no new reads). Six Workday rows change from 0, each named in workday_copy_held with the sibling that serves the base. All six state a feed total, so no page promised a watch on them before or after. The served map is a lower bound for the dedupe, which reads stored rows of any date. multi_site_promised_474dca30: the Workday zero pages 474dca30 promised a watch on whose tenant has another catalogued site; the promise is withheld on them now (the safe default: withholding is never false). single_site_promised: the Workday zero pages that keep it.
